body: An outgoing media row can only read as failed via status=='error' (isDeliveryFailed is never set by ChatEngine, only ChatAgentView). For media that means a NON-retryable uploadLocalMediaLocked reason, all of which fire before a single byte moves: invalid_local_media_uri, media_file_missing, media_file_read_failed, media_encrypt_failed, invalid_upload_url. Retryable reasons already hold the row at 'pending' and queue a draft. Added invalid_upload_url to the retryable set and a 0.5s re-check on media_file_missing.
